experience.title: Earlier Experience — Project and Operations Management
experience.body: Managed projects across agriculture, retail, and motorsport, including export operations, supplier coordination, and international events. Also contributed to an online video service at ALGATA.

experience.title: RPA Developer — Business Process Automation
experience.body: Developed UiPath automations for spreadsheet and accounting workflows, web data collection, and reporting.

experience.title: Full-Stack Development — Selected Projects
experience.body: Built and deployed web applications spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, and server infrastructure. Selected projects include SvitloE, am-am, Kolir.in, and Casino Royale Live.

experience.title: Lead Front-end Engineer — Maplezo
experience.body: Lead front-end development for a fintech platform and contribute to selected backend features. Built the portal, access management tools, and a reconciliation dashboard. Implemented exchange workflows with validation, status tracking, and third-party integrations.

portfolio.title: GR Shipping — Vehicle Import Calculator
portfolio.description: Built a React calculator for a vehicle import company. It helps customers estimate customs duties, taxes, and shipping costs before purchasing a vehicle in the US or Canada.

portfolio.title: Union Stone
portfolio.description: Developed a React website for a manufacturer of natural amber slabs and furniture. Built a product catalog with collection pages and image galleries so visitors can browse materials and see how they are used in interiors.

portfolio.title: AIK Trans — Freight Transport Website
portfolio.description: Built a responsive website for a freight transport company. The site presents its services and includes a quote request form with field validation.

portfolio.title: Casino Royale Live
portfolio.description: Built the Casino Royale Live platform end to end, including the player-facing website, admin panel, and backend API. Integrated games from a third-party provider into the platform’s lobby.

portfolio.title: Kolir.in
portfolio.description: Built and deployed a color palette generator that turns a word or phrase into a palette of 20 HEX colors. The API looks up existing palettes in MongoDB, generates new variants through the OpenAI API when fewer than five are stored, and reuses saved palettes once five variants are available.

portfolio.title: am-am
portfolio.description: Built and deployed a shared feeding tracker for families. The app supports multiple family groups and lets family administrators manage who can view, add, or edit feeding records. It gives caregivers a shared feeding history and statistics.

portfolio.title: SvitloE
portfolio.description: Designed and built a power availability monitoring system end to end. Developed and programmed an ESP32 device that sends heartbeat requests while powered. Built the server and a web dashboard where users activate devices with a code and choose where to receive power status notifications.

portfolio.title: Maplezo
portfolio.description: Led front-end engineering at Maplezo, a fintech company, and contributed to backend development on selected projects. Built the portal, sign-in and authorization flows, a reconciliation dashboard, and an admin panel for account creation and access management. Implemented a crypto exchange workflow with validation, status tracking, and third-party integrations.

portfolio.title: Arrow Puzzle
portfolio.description: Built a browser puzzle where players clear a path for the red arrow to leave the board. Implemented a puzzle generator with ten difficulty levels.

portfolio.title: Color Match
portfolio.description: Built a browser puzzle where players score by matching colored pieces in lines and 2×2 squares. Includes endless play and level-based challenges.

portfolio.title: Duck Sorter
portfolio.description: Built a browser game as a technical assignment. Players guide a dog to sort ducks by color, with adjustable numbers of ducks and colors.
